verdict.rationale: The session-management docs show configurable expiry (`expiresIn`, 7 days by default) and sliding refresh via `updateAge`, which extends expiration whenever a session is used. The security docs state that logged-in users can revoke their own sessions on other devices or browsers. Revocation is less well evidenced than expiry and refresh, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that revocation takes effect immediately server-side, an admin or server API to revoke another user's compromised session, and independent or hands-on corroboration of session lifecycle behavior.
